summary: Empery Digital Inc. filed an 8-K on July 6, 2026, reporting the early termination of its shareholder rights plan (poison pill) originally adopted February 3, 2025. The amendment accelerates the expiration of preferred share purchase rights from February 2, 2027, to July 6, 2026, and the rights agreement terminates upon close of business that day. No preferred shares were ever issued. The company will file a Certificate of Elimination to cancel the designated Series A Preferred stock. This is a routine corporate governance action, not a special situation event, and does not involve any transaction, activist campaign, or structural change.
